zh.title: 達美航空將暫停紐約甘迺迪機場（JFK）至橙縣約翰韋恩機場（SNA）航線 美國航空維持每日飛航
zh.summary: 達美航空將暫停紐約（JFK）至橙縣（SNA）航線；美國航空維持每日飛航
body: 達美航空（Delta Air Lines）將暫停紐約甘迺迪機場（JFK）至南加州橙縣約翰韋恩機場（SNA）的跨洲航線。
據Simple Flying報導，達美航空是在恢復這條航線約五個月後，準備再次暫停飛航；美國航空則維持這條航線每日飛航。

en.title: Delta to pause John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) to John Wayne Airport (SNA) route; American stays daily
en.summary: Delta to pause New York (JFK)–Orange County (SNA) flights five months after their return; American stays daily
body: Delta Air Lines is set to pause its transcontinental service between John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) in New York and John Wayne Airport (SNA) in Southern California.
The planned suspension comes about five months after Delta restored the route. American Airlines will continue daily service on the route, according to Simple Flying.
